newsitem.title: USA: Fleming Cos named in class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Cos named in class action suit.

text.p: Plaintiff attorneys said that they have filed a class action lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania on behalf of purchasers of the common stock of Fleming Cos Inc.
The attorneys said the complaint charges Fleming and Robert Stauth, the company's chairman and chief executive, with violations of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
They said the complaint alleges misrepresenting and/or omitting material information concerning litigation brought against Fleming by David's Supermarkets Inc.
On March 25, Fleming said it had agreed to settle litigation with David's by paying $19.9 million to David's.
David's had sued Fleming, alleging fraud and breach of contract.

A spokesman for Fleming said that the company said that the company considers its settlement of the David's case a "logjam breaker" and that Fleming will "deal with the (legal matters) spawned by the David's case in due course."
